name: 51774-manyimage-qwen2vl2b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: Concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 25%, bounded at 300 requests -> 225 measured. Expect ~2-3 minutes of measured window, plus model load.
workload: Single-turn multimodal chat: 48 tokens of instruction text followed by 512 separate 56x56 JPEG images in ONE user message, 16 output tokens, greedy (temperature 0). Every image is distinct. About 3,150 prompt tokens in, 16 out. Driven by guidellm through its in-process `vllm_python` backend rather than over HTTP.
purpose: A compact vision-language assistant captioning batches of 512 small images per request, one at a time, on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM built from commit 52c70b210ce9d66e9afb9d18e086c3d05408c492.
# Five keys are set; everything else is the engine default.

model: Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct

# HAZARD -- KEEP THIS ON ONE LINE. The config reader is flat: it skips every line beginning with a
# space, so a block-form dict never reaches AsyncEngineArgs and the limit would silently sit at its
# default while this file claimed 512. A value starting `{` is parsed as JSON, which survives.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 512}

max-model-len: 8192
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# COMPATIBILITY, not a workload choice. The startup FlashInfer autotune pass in this checkout
# imports a symbol that does not exist in the flashinfer this venv carries, and the engine dies
# during bring-up before anything is served. Nothing in this deployment dispatches to FlashInfer.
# See configs/note.md.
enable-flashinfer-autotune: false
